Next Steps

  • Once we’ve identified the concepts, artists and creative directions that resonate most, we can progress to availability, fees, intro negotiation and any bespoke opportunities.
  • Aim to also get deeper with the client, understand their general music tastes, and who and what they like out of the above. Client music consultancy available and/or we can share some questions. We’d love a link to their Spotify, or similar, if possible!
  • We can then revert with a more concise, relevant set of artists, along with availability and pricing. We can also include a playlist if and where relevant.

Proposal Terms

  • This proposal and any recommendations shared are exclusively for the purpose of evaluating entertainment options for this event.
  • The proposal is confidential, and may be shared for ‘internal’ planning purposes only, but may not be shared externally with artists, agencies, or unrelated third parties.
  • Non-circumvention obligation - any artists or suppliers recommended by Miro Sounds, within or outside of this proposal, must be booked through Miro Sounds, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
  • All ideas and recommendations are subject to availability.

About Us

We curate and coordinate exceptional music for unforgettable events. From the familiar to the fresh, the refined to the raw, we’ll find the perfect pairing of sound & setting to take your music and entertainment to the next level.

Bringing 15 years of expertise across music, events and sound curation, we source from a trusted global network of phenomenal musicians, handpicking authentic talent tailored for each event, without the restrictions of a fixed roster, ensuring every experience feels truly personal.

Tell us your vision and we’ll take it from there, fine-tuning every element to make sure it all flows seamlessly - initial consultation, genre & artist curation, booking & logistics, onsite management.
